item.description: Quentin Tarantino ’s films are full of fascinating casting what-ifs, from actors who nearly landed iconic roles to stars who slipped through his fingers. Michael Fassbender ’s memorable turn as British Lieutenant Archie Hicox seems like inspired casting in retrospect, but Tarantino originally had three very different actors in mind: at one point, Tim Roth , Johnny Depp , and then Simon Pegg .
